messages:
julia (Customer): Hey team—I redeemed promo code REDWOOD-DED-TRIAL but the credit landed on our Hosted project instead of Dedicated. We need it on our dedicated pool for staging. account: ac_87654321

sara (Support): Sorry about that, julia — can you confirm the promo code exactly and the last 4 of the billing account? I can check the ledger and escalate. :wave:

julia (Customer): Code is REDWOOD-DED-TRIAL. Billing acct last4: 4321. I noticed the Hosted quota went to $500 free trial and Dedicated stayed at $0. We spun up a dedicated pool and it's billing immediately.

sara (Support): Thanks. I see an automated application entry from billing-bot: `promo_apply_event` for ac_87654321 applied to sku: `hosted_small` amount: 500.00 USD. I'm pinging billing. @raj can you take a look?

raj (Billing): looking... I can see the event in the ledger: `evt_1Kx...` applied to product.sku=hosted_small. Can you paste the original redemption path? Did customer redeem from console or via sales?

sara (Support): julia — where did you paste the code? Hosted console "Billing" page (default) or in Dedicated subscription flow?

julia (Customer): I redeemed from the "Billing" > "Promos" page in the Console (default org landing). I assumed it would apply to our dedicated pool since docs mentioned dedicated trials, but UI shows hosted by default.

raj (Billing): Ok that explains it — promo was single-use config tied to account-level default sku. We can reassign the credit but need an internal approval step and an offset credit to keep totals consistent. I'll open a ticket BT-2379 and schedule the move.

sara (Support): ETA for reassign? We have a scheduled canary test tomorrow on the dedicated pool, customer needs it.

raj (Billing): I'll prioritize. Plan: 1) create internal reversal on hosted_invoice id `inv_9a7` for -$500, 2) create dedicated credit `cr_5b2` for +$500 on sku `dedicated_8xGPU`, 3) update ledger refs and send invoice notes. Doing steps now.

billing-bot: [automated] Ticket BT-2379 created by raj. Status: pending-approval. Approver: finance_lead.

ev an (Eng): quick FYI — redemption endpoints default to account.default_sku when applying promos. If default_sku is hosted_small this will happen; we should validate promo.allowed_skus on redemption to avoid accidental assignments. Filing ENG-issue.

raj (Billing): finance approved, executing reversal and new credit. Reversal id `rev_1023`, new credit id `cr_5b2`. Ledger entries updated.

sara (Support): julia, I applied the changes and verified: Hosted credit removed (balance decreased by $500) and Dedicated pool now has a credit of $500 attached to subscription `sub_dedicated_0007`. Could you verify you can see the credit in Console > Dedicated > Billing?

julia (Customer): I see it now under Dedicated -> Billing -> Credits. Thank you! Can you confirm no downtime or overage charges happened during the move?

raj (Billing): We backdated the credit to match the original apply time, so no overage invoices will be issued. I also issued a compensating hosted temporary credit in case anything shows up while systems sync (CR-temp-174).

sara (Support): Logged follow-ups: BT-2379 (billing), ENG-4321 (validation on redemption), DOCS-114 (clarify Console UX). Closing this thread after 48h if everything looks stable. :white_check_mark:

julia (Customer): All good here. Appreciate the fast help! :pray:

evan (Eng): small patch landed to validate promo.allowed_skus on redemption; won't go live til tomorrow rollout but will catch similar in future.

sara (Support): marking resolved for now; will reopen if any issue. Thanks everyone!
